Once, about 15 minutes and free:
1. In Google Cloud, create a project and enable “YouTube Data API v3”.
2. In “OAuth consent screen”, choose “External” and add the youtube.upload scope.
3. In “Credentials”, create an “OAuth client ID” of type “Desktop app” and download its JSON.
4. Click “Publish app” to move it to “In production”: in Testing the permission expires after 7 days.
5. Click “Connect YouTube”, choose that JSON and accept in the browser (if it says the app isn't verified: Advanced → Continue; it's your own app).
Do your first test with a short video: with an unverified project, YouTube might keep it private.
